escalations.title: Handlebars.js — JavaScript Injection / Remote Code Execution
escalations.description: 8 CVEs in Handlebars.js (direct dependency). Arbitrary code execution if user-controlled input reaches template rendering.

escalations.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution via OpenTelemetry chain
escalations.description: Critical RCE in protobufjs propagated through the entire OpenTelemetry/gRPC observability stack.
escalations.fix: npm audit fix --force in portal/Backend and platform/orchestrator (breaking change — requires test cycle)

escalations.title: @grpc/grpc-js — Certificate Validation Bypass + DoS
escalations.description: TLS certificate validation bypass allows MITM of gRPC traffic. Separate DoS via malformed HTTP/2 frames.
escalations.fix: npm install @grpc/grpc-js@1.14.5+ in portal/Backend and platform/orchestrator

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Reports False PASSED — Blind to Specifications/
p1_findings.description: Enforcer only scans Plans/*/requirements.md. Never reads Specifications/. 79 requirements invisible to the gate. All CI merge gate passes since project inception are false negatives.
p1_findings.fix: Extend enforcer to glob Specifications/**/*.md and parse FR-* IDs
p1_findings.cross_ref: Root Cause A — also drives QO-002 and QO-003

p1_findings.title: 69 Requirements in dev-workflow-platform.md — Zero Implementation
p1_findings.description: FR-001 through FR-069 define a complete platform never implemented. No // Verifies: FR-0XX comments anywhere in Source/.
p1_findings.fix: Product owner: archive spec (status: archived) or create roadmap tickets for each FR
p1_findings.cross_ref: Root Cause A — enforcer fix (QO-001) makes this visible

p1_findings.title: 10 Requirements in tiered-merge-pipeline.md — Zero Implementation
p1_findings.description: FR-TMP-001–010 (risk classification, E2E generation, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge) fully written, zero implementation.
p1_findings.fix: Add status: planned front matter or create implementation tickets

p1_findings.title: vitest — Multiple Critical Framework Vulnerabilities
p1_findings.description: vitest 2.x has critical vulnerabilities; upgrade to 5.0.3+ required. Compromised test runner can exfiltrate secrets.
p1_findings.fix: npm audit fix --force in each affected package; full test cycle required

p1_findings.title: postcss — XSS and Path Traversal
p1_findings.description: High CVSS XSS and path traversal vulnerabilities in postcss.
p1_findings.fix: npm audit fix in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: Dependency feature has no spec (free-form FR IDs)
p2_findings.description: BFS cycle detection, dispatch gating, cascade auto-dispatch built with free-form IDs (FR-dependency-*) appearing in no spec document.
p2_findings.fix: Write dependency spec section in Specifications/workflow-engine.md with canonical FR-WF-* IDs

p2_findings.title: Search route tested but not mounted in app.ts
p2_findings.description: search.test.ts has traceability comments and test cases, but no search route is mounted in app.ts. Tests hit 404 or test a handler never exposed to HTTP.
p2_findings.fix: Mount the route in app.ts OR delete the orphaned test file

p2_findings.title: form-data 4.0.0–4.0.5 — CRLF injection
p2_findings.fix: npm audit fix; review HTTP request handling for CRLF vectors

p2_findings.title: Jest ecosystem — cascading CVEs in 30+ packages
p2_findings.fix: npm audit fix --force with full test suite regression

p3_findings.title: Dual logger shim — violates single-source-of-truth rule
p3_findings.description: src/logger.ts wraps src/utils/logger.ts as compatibility shim. Two import paths for same utility.
p3_findings.fix: Consolidate to single logger; update all imports

p3_findings.title: Four incompatible FR ID namespaces
p3_findings.description: FR-001, FR-WF-001, FR-TMP-001, FR-dependency-* coexist with no governing convention in CLAUDE.md
p3_findings.fix: Define canonical FR ID convention in CLAUDE.md; migrate free-form IDs

p3_findings.title: Two unexplained eslint-disable suppressions
p3_findings.fix: Add comment explaining why the dependency is intentionally excluded, or fix the hook

p3_findings.title: portal/Backend: 578 transitive dependencies (threshold <200)
p3_findings.description: 1:26 direct-to-transitive ratio represents excessive supply chain attack surface
p3_findings.fix: Dependency tree optimization / monorepo refactoring; deduplication tools (depcheck, npm-check-updates)

p3_findings.title: TypeScript 5→7, React 18→19, Vite 5→8 — 1–3 major versions behind
p3_findings.description: Coordinated major-version upgrade needed across all packages

cross_reference_map.root_cause: A — Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/
B — No automated CVE scanning in CI
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add npm audit --audit-level=high as CI gate; set up Dependabot
Define canonical FR ID convention in CLAUDE.md; migrate all IDs
